title: GitHub
intro: Let your agents read the code, issues and pull requests of the repositories you list. The agent can read only those, with the token you save here. Nothing is written to GitHub.
name: Name
tokenHelp: Starts with github_pat_. Give it read access to the repositories below only: Contents, Issues and Pull requests. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
tokenSaved: Saved. Type a token to replace it.
tokenShape: Use a fine-grained token: it starts with github_pat_.
reposHelp: One per line, as owner/name. {{count}} listed. The agent is refused any other repository, even if the token could reach it.
writeOff: Write access is off: this connection only reads.

check.readWrite: {{repo}}: reachable. The token could also write, so give it read access only.

noRepos: No repositories listed: the agent can read none.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The agent can no longer read these repositories, and the token saved with it is deleted. To set it up again you must enter the token again.

setup.title: How to make the token
setup.step1: On GitHub, open Settings, Developer settings, Fine-grained personal access tokens, and make a new token.
setup.step2: Under Repository access, choose Only select repositories and pick the ones you list here.
setup.step3: Under Permissions, give Read access to Contents, Issues and Pull requests. Leave everything else off.
